chapters.title: My Story
chapters.subtitle: A journey written in quiet milestones, creative leaps and code
chapters.quote: Every line of code and every song begins with a single, quiet thought.

items.title: Where My Journey Began · First Code Workspace
items.caption: A cozy laptop desk glowing with late-night lines of code. The moment console.log('Hello, World!') ran, a software builder was born.
items.description: Palak's inception into Computer Science and Business Systems: combining creative curiosity with full-stack engineering logic.

items.title: Stepping into Computer Science & Business Systems
items.caption: Learning both sides of the coin: clean algorithmic software craft and real business product architecture.
items.description: Formal engineering studies at SIRT Bhopal, building analytical foundations and scalable architectures.

items.title: PRICORA-AI · Dynamic Pricing Intelligence Engine
items.caption: From initial whiteboard idea to full-stack production. Built with React, Node.js, and real-time market telemetry.
items.description: Engineered live price scraping, competitive analytics dashboard, and dynamic pricing models.

items.title: Sentinel AI · Smart Security & Anomaly Detection
items.caption: Intelligent anomaly detection system with real-time alert monitors, vision feeds, and backend telemetry.
items.description: Collaborative engineering effort integrating computer vision security models with modern UI.

chapters.title: My Talents & Melodies
chapters.subtitle: Acoustic singing sessions, vocal harmonies & creative music
chapters.quote: Where melody meets engineering: art that breathes life into logic.

items.title: Romantic & Acoustic Melodies
items.caption: Acoustic singing session & vocal harmony
items.description: Vocal recording capturing romantic notes and acoustic nuances.

items.title: Heartfelt Vocal Performance
items.caption: Singing covers & expressive acoustic notes
items.description: Heartfelt singing recording exploring melodic depth and rhythm.

items.title: Acoustic Chords & Soulful Harmonies
items.caption: When screens turn off, music begins. Unplugged chords, soothing guitar rhythms, and soulful singing covers.
items.description: Acoustic jamming session at dusk. Finding comfort in acoustic melodies between programming sprints.

items.title: Vintage Vinyl & Classical Melodies
items.caption: Warm crackle of analog records. Slow evenings spent listening to timeless melodies and old soulful hits.
items.description: Spinning retro records on an old turntable. A reminder that classic craftsmanship never goes out of style.

chapters.title: Travel Diaries
chapters.subtitle: Real destinations, misty mountain trails, lakes & temple gopurams
chapters.quote: To travel is to collect sunsets and keep them between paper pages.

items.title: Golden Hour Glow · Upper Lake Bhopal
items.caption: Golden sunlight dancing across Bhopal's serene Bada Talab waters. Evening breezes, lakeside chai, and quiet contemplation.
items.description: Photographed at VIP Road, Bhopal. The water shimmered like molten amber as the city lights began to twinkle.

items.title: Misty Mountain Morning · Satpura Hills Pachmarhi
items.caption: Misty layers of blue and green rolling across the Satpura mountain ranges at dawn. Cold pine breezes and silent horizons.
items.description: Witnessed from Dhoopgarh, the highest point in Madhya Pradesh. Walking through misty forest paths as morning fog lifted.

items.title: Temple Gopurams & Sacred Hills · Tamil Nadu
items.caption: Magnificent temple gopuram towers rising against scenic mountain hills. Rich Dravidian architecture and cultural heritage.
items.description: Exploring ancient temples in Tamil Nadu. The intricate sculptures, peaceful courtyards, and scenic hillside backdrops.

items.title: Enchanted Woods & Wild Deer · Satpura Trails
items.caption: Quiet encounter with a wild deer standing peacefully among ancient trees in the morning mist.
items.description: Deeper into the Satpura woodland trails. Sunbeams filtering through tall trees illuminating an enchanted forest scene.

items.title: Cold Mountain Waterfalls & Natural Springs
items.caption: Natural freshwater pools hidden deep inside the ravine. Clear, freezing water cascading over smooth canyon rocks.
items.description: Bee Falls and Duchess Fall hike. The thunderous echo of cascading water and refreshing mountain pools.

items.title: Steaming Filter Kaapi & Crispy Dosa Delights
items.caption: Crispy golden masala dosa served on banana leaf with fresh coconut chutneys and traditional brass tumbler filter coffee.
items.description: Traditional breakfast stop during the South Indian road trip. The rich aroma of roasted chicory and spices.

chapters.title: Memories
chapters.subtitle: College days at SIRT Bhopal, creative sketches, celebrations & little moments
chapters.quote: Photographs and handwritten notes: tiny time capsules of people and places that made us.

items.title: Canteen Chai & Architecture Debates
items.caption: Post-class debates over cutting chai and samosas at the campus canteen. Talking about cloud backends and future blueprints.
items.description: SIRT Bhopal canteen bench. Where some of our most ambitious project roadmaps were sketched on paper napkins.

items.title: Cozy Cottage Garden · Handcrafted Ink Sketch
items.caption: A quiet cottage surrounded by flowering hedges and stone pathways. Sketched with fine-liner ink on textured paper.
items.description: Drawn on a Sunday afternoon with a cup of masala chai. Visualizing tranquil homes tucked away in misty valleys.

items.title: Botanical Wildflowers · Watercolor & Fineliner
items.caption: Delicate wildflower stems, leaves, and soft floral petals studied from roadside trails and meadows.
items.description: Watercolor washes over delicate pigment ink lines. Preserving seasonal blossoms inside paper spreads.

items.title: Creative Chibi Doodle · Hand-drawn Sticker
items.caption: Playful chibi cartoon doodle of an ambitious tech girl holding books and wearing oversized glasses.
items.description: Hand-drawn sticker illustration bringing lighthearted warmth to engineering notebook margins.

items.title: Charcoal Monochrome Highlights
items.caption: Soft charcoal shading and bold graphite pencil strokes exploring depth, light, and monochrome shadow.
items.description: Experimenting with charcoal powder, blending stumps, and kneaded erasers to capture expressive shadows.

items.title: Old Bookstore & Hardcover Shelves
items.caption: Wandering through narrow wooden aisles surrounded by thousands of pre-loved books and quiet study corners.
items.description: Finding rare programming guides and philosophical essays tucked away on vintage cedar shelves.

items.title: Steaming Masala Chai Brew · Daily Ritual
items.caption: Crushed green cardamom, fresh ginger, cloves, and whole milk simmered to a rich golden caramel hue.
items.description: The ritual that starts every productive coding session. A steaming earthen kulhad on the balcony.
